info.title: UC44 — THG Reporting API
info.description: Backend for the Hamburger Hochbahn THG-reporting prototype. Drives the four-step flow shown in the sketch: upload, plausibility check (model 1), regrouping (model 2), dashboard.

get.summary: Validate the bearer token; returns 200 on success, 401 otherwise.

schema.title: Response Check Api Auth Check Get

get.summary: Whether the server requires authentication (no token needed).

schema.title: Response Status Api Auth Status Get

post.summary: Upload an invoice Excel file
Load the bundled HHA sample invoice file (5000 rows).
Drop the in-memory session state.

schema.title: Response Reset Session Api Upload Reset Post

post.summary: Run plausibility model 1 over the uploaded invoices.
Record the user's decision on a single plausibility row.

schema.title: Response Decision Api Plausibility Decision Post

get.summary: Return the Warengruppe catalog the prediction model picks from.

schema.title: Response Catalog Api Prediction Catalog Get

post.summary: Run prediction model 2 over the entries flagged implausible by model 1.
Record the user's decision on a single regrouping suggestion.

schema.title: Response Decision Api Prediction Decision Post

delete.summary: Undo a single decision (back to pending) without touching the others.

schema.title: Response Clear Decision Api Prediction Decision  Row Index  Delete

get.summary: Aggregate KPIs, funnel and Top-WG ranking for the dashboard view.
Combined token spend across both models.

schema.title: Response List Runs Api Runs Get

post.summary: Start the two-stage analysis for the active run in the background.

get.summary: Poll a run's progress (derived live from the DB).
Diff baseline vs. memory predictions for a run (spot-check changes).
Resume a run: rebuild it from the DB and make it the active run.

schema.title: Response List Warengruppen Api Warengruppen Get

post.summary: Create a Warengruppe (generates a wg_id if none is given).

get.summary: Get a single Warengruppe by its wg_id.

delete.summary: Delete a Warengruppe and its emission factors (blocked if referenced).

schema.title: Response Delete Warengruppe Api Warengruppen  Wg Id  Delete

post.summary: Delete several Warengruppen at once by their wg_ids (skips referenced).
Deactivate a Warengruppe (hidden from the LLM, kept for history).
Re-activate a Warengruppe (offered to the LLM again).
Activate or deactivate several Warengruppen at once by their wg_ids.
Bulk-import Warengruppen from an XLSX/CSV upload (upsert by wg_id).
Generate a proposal (atomic, not saved).
Incorporate annotations (atomic).

get.summary: Manual in-/out-flux (correction history) for one Warengruppe.
In-/out-flux counts for every Warengruppe (wizard selection badges).

schema.title: Response History Signals Api Enrichment History Signals Get
Response List Batches Api Enrichment Batch Get

post.summary: Start a bulk enrichment batch (background).
Apply a proposal to its Warengruppe.
Reject a proposal.
Refine a proposal with annotations.

BulkActiveResult.title: BulkActiveResult
BulkActiveResult.description: Outcome of a bulk activate/deactivate: how many changed, which were unknown.

BulkDeleteRequest.title: BulkDeleteRequest
BulkDeleteRequest.description: Delete several Warengruppen at once by their business keys.

BulkDeleteResult.title: BulkDeleteResult
BulkDeleteResult.description:
Outcome of a bulk delete: how many were removed, which were unknown.

`blocked` lists ids that were kept because they are still referenced by
historical data (see the delete protection in `services/warengruppen.py`);
those should be deactivated instead of deleted.

plan.description: Default per-field plan; None → derive per WG from its state.

BulkEnrichRequest.title: BulkEnrichRequest
BulkEnrichRequest.description: Start a background enrichment batch over the selected Warengruppen.

ChangeLogRecord.title: ChangeLogRecord
ChangeLogRecord.description: A historised decision event, shaped for the frontend audit log.

ComparisonItem.title: ComparisonItem
ComparisonItem.description: One sample where the memory-assisted run disagreed with the baseline.

ComparisonResult.title: ComparisonResult
ComparisonResult.description: Baseline vs. memory predictions for a run, for human spot-checking.

new_wg_name.title: New Wg Name
new_wg_name.description: Target Warengruppe when the user remaps a row (decision 'regroup'/'new_wg'). Persisted as the new_value of the historised decision event.

old_value.title: Old Value
old_value.description: Previous Warengruppe/decision value, for the audit trail.

DecisionState.title: DecisionState
DecisionState.description: The current (newest) decision for a sample, to restore the review table.

EmissionsfaktorRow.title: EmissionsfaktorRow
EmissionsfaktorRow.description: One spend-based emission factor (kg CO2e / €) for a reporting year.

EnrichApplyRequest.title: EnrichApplyRequest
EnrichApplyRequest.description: Apply a proposal to its Warengruppe; `content` overrides with edited values.

EnrichBatchDetail.title: EnrichBatchDetail
EnrichBatchDetail.description: A batch's status plus its proposals — the review queue payload.

EnrichBatchStatus.title: EnrichBatchStatus
EnrichBatchStatus.description: Pollable progress of an enrichment batch — derived from the DB.

EnrichContent.title: EnrichContent
EnrichContent.description: The current field values a suggestion is based on (may hold unsaved edits).

EnrichPlan.title: EnrichPlan
EnrichPlan.description: Per-field action for one enrichment call. Defaults to full generation.

EnrichProposal.title: EnrichProposal
EnrichProposal.description: One persisted proposal in a batch's review queue.

EnrichRefineRequest.title: EnrichRefineRequest
EnrichRefineRequest.description: Atomic refine: incorporate per-field annotations into the current draft.

wg_id.title: Wg Id
wg_id.description: For the history signal; may be omitted for unsaved/new WGs.

EnrichRequest.title: EnrichRequest
EnrichRequest.description: Atomic generate: work on the given content (plan=None → auto-derive).

EnrichSuggestion.title: EnrichSuggestion
EnrichSuggestion.description: An LLM enrichment proposal (not yet saved). Mirrors the notebook JSON.

FieldAnnotations.title: FieldAnnotations
FieldAnnotations.description: Free-text 'Anmerkung für KI' per field, fed back into the refine call.

HistoryItem.title: HistoryItem
HistoryItem.description: One aggregated manual-correction pattern (a Bestelltext), for the signal.

HistorySignal.title: HistorySignal
HistorySignal.description:
Manual in-/out-flux for a Warengruppe — the enrichment history signal.

influx  = rows a human manually moved INTO this WG (decision_event.new_value)
          → its description/examples_enthalten likely miss these cases.
outflux = rows a human manually moved OUT of this WG (old_value)
          → its examples_nicht_enthalten / scope boundary should be sharpened.

ImportResult.title: ImportResult
ImportResult.description: Outcome of a catalog import (upsert by wg_id).

betrag_eur.title: Betrag Eur
betrag_eur.description: Invoice amount in EUR from the uploaded file, if an amount column was present.

betrag_eur.title: Betrag Eur
betrag_eur.description: Invoice amount in EUR from the uploaded file, if an amount column was present.

ProposalRefineRequest.title: ProposalRefineRequest
ProposalRefineRequest.description: Refine a persisted proposal with per-field annotations (bulk review loop).

RunDetail.title: RunDetail
RunDetail.description: Everything needed to resume a run: rebuilt from the DB (no LLM re-run).

max_rows.title: Max Rows
max_rows.description: Cap rows for demo speed. Null = run on the full file.

enable_hints.title: Enable Hints
enable_hints.description: Inject retrieved similar confirmed cases into the prediction prompt.

hint_threshold.title: Hint Threshold
hint_threshold.description: Min cosine similarity for a case to be used as a hint.

memo_threshold.title: Memo Threshold
memo_threshold.description: Cosine memoization threshold (secondary). Primary memoization is an exact feature_key match; templated texts cluster high, so keep this near 1.0.

RunStatus.title: RunStatus
RunStatus.description: Lightweight, pollable run progress — all derived from the DB.

RunSummary.title: RunSummary
RunSummary.description: One persisted Lauf, for the history picker.

warengruppe_count.title: Warengruppe Count
warengruppe_count.description: Distinct Warengruppe IDs present in the uploaded invoices.

aktiv.title: Aktiv
aktiv.description: Whether the Warengruppe is active. Inactive ones are no longer offered to the LLM as a suggestion target, but stay available for historical emission calculation and the audit trail. Toggle via the activate/deactivate endpoints, not the upsert payload.

WarengruppeRow.title: WarengruppeRow
WarengruppeRow.description: A Warengruppe in the catalog, with its per-year emission factors.

wg_id.title: Wg Id
wg_id.description: Business key. Omit on create to generate one ('new-<uuid>').

WarengruppeUpsertRequest.title: WarengruppeUpsertRequest
WarengruppeUpsertRequest.description: Create/update payload. `wg_id` is optional on create (generated).
